text:
tara_cs: quick thread — just finished calls with 3 onboarding customers, seeing a repeating theme on billing visibility and feature expectations. sharing notes and asking for prioritization help.

mike_csm: can you paste the verbatim quotes? those help product more.

tara_cs: yup — short excerpts: 
- 'we can't tell which routes are causing our token spikes'
- 'the onboarding checklist hides the per-route quotas'
- 'when we hit a rate limit it surfaces a generic error, not the route'
all 3 said they'd convert faster if they could trace costs to features.

jana_product: this is good — ties to the roadmap but we need severity estimates. how many accounts, renewal risk?

tara_cs: two are mid-market (contract Q3), one is SMB internal pilot. mid-market accounts reported +40% weekly token volatility on mapped routes; both called out renewals as at-risk if we can't show per-route cost controls.

alex_pm: propose a quick triage rubric:
- impact (accounts affected, renewal window) = weight 5
- frequency (how often they see it) = weight 3
- engineering effort (rough S,M,L) = weight -2 (lower better)
- detectability (can we show via logs/console today) = binary 0/1 * weight 2
we can score and pick top 2 to fast-follow.

sam_eng: from infra POV, adding per-route cost breakdown in the console is doable as an incremental metric pipeline: estimate 2 wks to add counters + 1 wk UI. surface flags and link to usage.

jana_product: thanks — can you give a 1-line technical risk note?

sam_eng: risk: attribution for batched requests needs mapping pipeline (route -> request group). low complexity but needs test coverage.

mike_csm: I can surface the quotes in renewal cadences and ask for a short call with product for the two mid-market next week.

tara_cs: also note customers asked for clearer error messages (route id + example payload) — that might be smaller win.

alex_pm: small wins first: 1) improve error payloads to include route id (estimate 3 days) 2) add a console toggle to show per-route summary using existing counters (estimate 2 wks). major work: full cost-attribution pipeline (2-4 wks).

jana_product: agreed. mike — can you gather any screenshots of the error flows and paste here by EOD? we'll run the rubric after that and put into the next prioritization sync. tagging @ops_bot to create a tracking ticket if we decide to proceed.

mike_csm: will do. attaching one screenshot link: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/ok-123 (note: cropped PII).

ops_bot: created ticket RI-4521 "Per-route cost visibility + better error messages" assigned to sam_eng, priority: provisional.

tara_cs: thanks all. if we score this high I'll prep a short customer-facing note explaining timelines and mitigations for renewals.

alex_pm: one more ask — can we capture the expected ROI ("will help close renewal" or "reduce churn risk") as a field in the ticket? helps sales.

mike_csm: adding: Mid-market A: likely move to pilot -> paid if resolved (renewal in 90 days). Mid-market B: 60% renewal risk. SMB pilot: low risk but strong feature ask.

jana_product: perfect. I'll add weights and run it through the next prioritization meeting. thanks everyone.

tara_cs: end.
